la:verb:cooperor.gloss: to work together with another; to cooperate
senses: to work together with another; to cooperate
la:verb:cooperor.html:
cŏ-ŏpĕror, ātus sum, 1,
v. dep., to work with or together, combine, unite (late Lat.): praedicaverunt ubique, Domino coöperante,; .—
Transf., of things: quoniam fides coöperabatur operibus ejus,: diligentibus Deum omnia cooperantur in bonum,.

la:verb:cooperio.gloss: to cover wholly or over, overwhelm, clothe
senses: to cover wholly or over, overwhelm, clothe
la:verb:cooperio.html:
cŏ-ŏpĕrĭo, rŭi, rtum, 4 (contr. form coperiunt, ; cf. Lachm. ap. ),
v. a., to cover wholly, to cover, cover over, overwhelm (class.; most freq. in part. perf.).
Lit.
Verb finit.: Cyrsilum quendam lapidibus cooperuerunt,; so : tempestas atque tenebrae maria ac terras,; : radices,: se multā fronde (vitis),.—
Part. perf.: coöperta membra pannis,; so ap. : corpus telis,: Pomptinum omne velut nubibus locustarum,; ; : iste lapidibus in foro,. —
Trop.: fenoribus coöpertus est, overwhelmed, buried in, Cato and Sall. ap. ; in part.: tot, tantis, tam nefariis sceleribus,: flagitiis atque facinoribus,: miseriis,: famosis versibus, * ; cf.: onerare aliquem maledictis,.

la:verb:coorior.html:
cŏ-ŏrĭor, ortus, 4,
v. dep., to come forth, stand up, arise, appear, rise, break forth (class. in prose and poetry; most freq. in Lucr. and the hist., esp. Liv.; in Cic. rare, perh. only once).
In gen.: ubi materiaï Ex infinito sunt corpora plura coorta,; cf. ; ; : ignes pluribus simul locis, et saep.: bellum,: de integro coörtum est bellum,; cf.: foedum certamen,: seditio intestina coörta,: risus omnium cum hilaritate,: dolores,; ; cf. : accipere febrim calido fervore coortam,.—
In partic.
Of natural phenomena, storms, etc., to arise, break out, begin, etc.: saeva tempestas,; so, tempestas,; ; ; ; et saep.: ventus,; ; ; : taetra nimborum nox,; .—Poet., of events, to happen: quasi naufragiis magnis multisque coörtis,.—
Of a hostile rising, to stand up, rise, to break forth, etc.
Absol.: Romani velut tum primum signo dato coorti pugnam integram ediderunt,; cf. ; ; ; ; : insidiae,; ; cf. : tum libero conquestu coortae voces sunt,: magno in populo, cum seditio coorta est,.—
With prep.: coorti in pugnam,: in nos Sarmatarum ac Suevorum gentes,; : in has rogationes nostras,: ad bellum,, : adversus quos infestior coorta optimatium acies,.
